D1: Fixed the mobile bridge relay client so it reconnects with exponential backoff, capped at 30 seconds, after a router restart, and the status bar now shows a Reconnecting state.
D2: Release 0.5.0, a version release task with no description or recorded changes.
D3: Fixed the pairing QR code contrast in the mobile PairingCard component so the QR code renders on a white tile in both the dark and light themes.
D4: Added search to the docs site, with a search box in the header backed by a prebuilt search index.
D5: Considered showing the latest release version in the docs header, but decided against it because the docs are versionless and the changelog already names each release. No change was made.
D6: Debounced the window resize handler in the useTerminal hook so terminals re-fit once per 200 ms burst, which removed the stutter with many panes open.
D7: Restructured the website docs so the getting-started guide walks through the first task end to end, and moved the configuration reference to its own page, with duplicate screenshots cut.
D8: Sorted the sidebar project list by last opened, most recent first, in the ProjectList component.
D9: Added a count badge beside the Backlog entry in the sidebar (BacklogEntry component) to show the backlog count.
D10: Persisted the sidebar width by saving it to config on drag end and restoring it on launch, changing the config manager and the Sidebar layout component.
